name: Customer Cheque Report
sql_query:
SELECT
    DATE(q.created_at)                                       AS received_date,
    q.cheques_no                                             AS cheque_no,
    q.bank,
    q.branch_code                                            AS bank_branch,
    q.acc_no                                                 AS account_no,
    q.due_date,
    CASE q.trans_type
        WHEN 'SALE'             THEN 'Sales Invoice'
        WHEN 'CUSTOMER_PAYMENT' THEN 'Customer Payment'
        WHEN 'CUSTOMER_ADVANCE' THEN 'Advance Payment'
        WHEN 'HP_DOWN_PAYMENT'  THEN 'HP Down Payment'
        WHEN 'HP_INSTALLMENT'   THEN 'HP Installment'
        WHEN 'HP_CONVERSION'    THEN 'HP Cash Conversion'
        ELSE REPLACE(q.trans_type, '_', ' ')
    END                                                      AS received_for,
    q.trans_no                                               AS reference_no,
    cu.Code                                                  AS customer_code,
    cu.name                                                  AS customer_name,
    cu.phone                                                 AS customer_phone,
    q.amount,
    CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(q.status, 1)), SUBSTRING(q.status, 2)) AS status,
    q.realized_date,
    COALESCE(CONCAT(bd.bank_name, ' - ', bd.account_no), '') AS deposited_to,
    q.return_reason,
    CASE
        WHEN q.status = 'pending' AND q.due_date < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), q.due_date)
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                      AS days_overdue
FROM t_cus_cheques q
LEFT JOIN t_invoice_sums s           ON q.trans_type = 'SALE'             AND s.Invoice_no = q.trans_no
LEFT JOIN t_customer_payments p      ON q.trans_type = 'CUSTOMER_PAYMENT' AND p.Payment_no = q.trans_no
LEFT JOIN t_advanc_cus_payments v    ON q.trans_type = 'CUSTOMER_ADVANCE' AND v.payment_no = q.trans_no
LEFT JOIN t_hire_purchase_to_sales t ON q.trans_type = 'HP_CONVERSION'    AND t.conversion_no = q.trans_no
LEFT JOIN t_hire_purchase_sums h     ON h.invoice_no = CASE q.trans_type
        WHEN 'HP_DOWN_PAYMENT' THEN REPLACE(q.trans_no, '-DP', '')
        WHEN 'HP_INSTALLMENT'  THEN (SELECT MIN(ip.invoice_no) FROM t_hp_installment_payments ip
                                      WHERE ip.collection_no = q.trans_no OR ip.payment_no = q.trans_no)
        WHEN 'HP_CONVERSION'   THEN t.invoice_no
    END
LEFT JOIN customers cu ON cu.BC = q.BC AND (
        cu.Code = COALESCE(s.customer_code, h.customer_code)
     OR cu.NIC  = COALESCE(p.Customer_NIC, v.customer_nic))
LEFT JOIN bank_details bd ON bd.id = q.bank_detail_id
WHERE q.BC = :bc
  AND (
      (COALESCE(:date_by, 'due') = 'due' AND q.due_date BETWEEN :from AND :to)
   OR (:date_by = 'received'             AND DATE(q.created_at) BETWEEN :from AND :to)
   OR (:date_by = 'realized'             AND q.realized_date BETWEEN :from AND :to)
  )
  AND (:status   IS NULL OR q.status = :status)
  AND (:customer IS NULL OR cu.Code  = :customer)
  AND (:search   IS NULL OR q.cheques_no LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                         OR q.bank       LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                         OR q.trans_no   LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%'))
ORDER BY q.due_date, q.cheques_no;
